title: 第23章 特殊体质 重瞳第24章 拔剑斩天术无始道金
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
嗯？
陆尘看到眼前突然出现的半透明面板之上陆续出现的文字却是愣住了。
还有主线任务？
现阶段的主线任务。
收服或者毁灭四大家族！
这个任务，好像不难吧。
毕竟，自己获得的杀手组织地府，可是拥有天人境界。
如此恐怖的力量，想要收服四大家族还不是轻轻松松。
不过，这个任务奖励。
仙级功法……
陆尘本以为最高级别的功法便是天阶极品功法。
没有想到，还有仙品功法。
这仙品就是天级之上的品阶嘛？
摇了摇头，暂时不想那么多。
不过，虽然收服毁灭四大家族看起来轻而易举。
但是想要完成，也不是一件简单的事情。
毕竟，青帝应该也是天人境界，为什么不把四大家族直接给灭了？
反而放任着四大家族在自己眼前蹦跶恶心自己？
是不想嘛？
不，是因为四大家族在大乾身边根基深厚，牵连甚广。

长呼了一口气，陆尘决定还是从头记忆的好。
然而，就在这时，陆尘眼前半透明面板之上再次有文字陆续浮现。
【如今，你虽然让你的父亲青帝感受到震撼，并且满足了青帝一个心愿，但是如今青帝还有青帝众子还是被当今皇帝陆轩软禁在深宫之中，没有自由！】
【发布逆袭任务：你需要想办法帮助你父亲青帝离开皇宫，你父亲青帝乃气运深厚之人，离开皇宫的囚禁，或许还能遇到滔天机缘，重振雄风！】
【任务奖励：重瞳！】
“嗯？”
又发布一个任务？
不过也对，刚才的任务是主线任务。
而眼前这个任务应该是支线任务。
不过，带父皇离开皇宫，滔天机缘，重振雄风？
陆尘有些头疼的挠挠头。
这提前出现的逆袭系统就这点不好。
时间线不对，发布的任务也有参差。
有时候极难的任务能够轻松完成。但是有时候又不一样了。
不过，如果只是带青帝离开皇宫的话……
父皇不是还欠自己一个要求嘛？
自己身为儿子，请求父皇带着自己两人离开皇宫，在帝都城中转转，散散心，玩儿一玩儿总没有问题吧。
毕竟这个任务简励！
content_en:
Um?
Lu Chen was stunned when he saw the text appearing one after another on the translucent panel that suddenly appeared in front of him.
And the main quest?
The main mission at this stage.
Conquer or destroy the four major families!
This task doesn't seem difficult.
After all, the killer organization underworld that he obtained has the realm of heaven and human.
With such a terrifying power, it is not easy to conquer the four major families.
However, this mission rewards.
Immortal level skills...
Lu Chen originally thought that the highest level of skills was the top level skills of heaven.
I didn't expect that there are immortal skills.
Is this immortal grade a grade above heaven level?
He shook his head, not thinking about that much for the time being.
However, although it seems easy to conquer and destroy the four major families.
But it is not an easy thing to complete.
After all, Qing Emperor should be in the realm of heaven and human, so why not just destroy the four major families?
Instead, he allowed the four major families to dance around in front of him, making him feel disgusted?
Don't you want to?
No, it's because the four major families have deep roots around Daqian and are widely involved.
After taking a long breath, Lu Chen decided that it would be better to remember it from the beginning.
However, at this moment, words appeared again on the translucent panel in front of Chase Lu's eyes.
[Now, although you have shocked your father, Qing Emperor, and granted Qing Emperor one of his wishes, Qing Emperor and his sons are still under house arrest in the palace by the current emperor, Lu Xuan, with no freedom! 】
[Release of counterattack mission: You need to find a way to help your father Qing Emperor leave the palace. Your father Qing Emperor is a man of great luck. If you leave the imprisonment of the palace, you may encounter great opportunities and regain your glory! 】
[Task reward: Double pupils! 】
"Huh?"
Publish another task?
But that's right, the mission just now was the main mission.
The task in front of me should be a side task.
However, taking his father out of the palace and having great opportunities to regain his glory?
Lu Chen scratched his head with a headache.
This is the bad thing about the counterattack system that appeared in advance.
The timeline is wrong, and the tasks released are also inconsistent.
Sometimes extremely difficult tasks can be accomplished easily. But sometimes it's different.
However, if we just take Emperor Qing out of the palace...
Doesn’t his father still owe him a request?
As a son, I asked my father to take me and the two of us out of the palace, walk around the imperial capital, relax, and have some fun.
After all, this mission is simple!
